Your first screen is ready. You can open it in your browser at **http://maker:4001**

Let's walk through just **one thing** — the moment you save a link:

1. In the **"Paste a link"** box, paste this: `https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/map`
2. Press **"Get details"** and watch what happens.
3. The app fills in a **title and description** for you — tweak either if you like.
4. Add a tag (e.g. `reference`) and, if you want, a short note like `handy JS cheatsheet`.
5. Press **"Save bookmark"** and see it appear in your list below.

A few things I decided for you here — please tell me if any feel off:

- **I made "get details" a button you press** after pasting, rather than the app grabbing details the instant you paste. I wasn't sure which feels better, so this is one I'd especially like your reaction to.
- **I chose which fields you get:** an auto-filled title and description, plus optional tags and a note. I assumed **tags are typed as words separated by commas**.
- **The saved link shows title, address, description, your tags, and your note** — I decided that layout.

Give it a try, and tell me: **does saving a link feel the way you'd want it to?** If something's missing or the flow feels wrong, just say so in your own words.
